bill.title: Supplier’s bill
bill.hint: Copy the bill as it is printed: one line for each VAT rate, with its amount before tax and the taxes on it.
bill.hint_gross: Copy the bill as it is printed: one line for each VAT rate, with what it costs taxes included and the taxes on it. A bill of one line is entered by its total, fixed amounts included.
bill.gross_hint_near: That is about {{net}} {{currency}} before tax: no amount before tax gives exactly this total, so enter the tax amounts as printed once the expense is saved.
bill.charges_hint: Tick those the bill carries, such as the revenue stamp.
bill.printed_hint: Leave empty when the bill prints the amount worked out. A supplier’s rounding is accepted up to the currency’s smallest unit a line.
bill.printed_later: Once the expense is saved, you can enter the tax amounts as the bill prints them.
bill.net_positive: The amount must be above zero.
bill.net_pattern: An amount, with no more decimals than the currency has.
bill.one_vat: A line carries one VAT rate: add a line for the other rate.
bill.gross_charges: The total must be more than the fixed amounts ticked.
bill.gross_unknown: A rate or fixed amount on this line is no longer offered: enter it before tax.

expenses.amount_to_check_hint: This draft comes from a recurring expense whose amount changes: check it against the bill received, then record the expense.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.intro: Rent, electricity, internet: on each due date, a copy of the chosen expense is prepared as a draft for a person to check and record. Nothing is recorded by itself. One is made from an expense, with “Make recurring”.
recurring.no_company: Choose a company to see its recurring expenses.
recurring.none: No recurring expense. Open an expense and choose “Make recurring”.

fields.ends_on_hint: Leave empty for it to go on.
fields.variable_amount: The amount changes with each bill
fields.variable_amount_hint: Each draft is marked “Amount to check” until someone records it.

make.title: When to prepare the copy
make.intro: Each due date prepares a draft copied from this expense, dated that day, without its reference, attachments or payment. Nothing is recorded without you.

recurring.made: The expense is recurring: its first draft will be prepared when the day comes.
recurring.resumed: Recurring expense “{{description}}” resumed: the due dates passed while paused are skipped.

errors.invalid: The recurring expense could not be saved.
errors.not_found: This recurring expense no longer exists.
errors.network: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.
errors.startsOn: The first draft is made today or later, never on a past day.
errors.endsOn: The last day comes on or after the first draft's day.

form.withholding_hint_from: Proposed at {{rate}}% from {{threshold}} including taxes, without fixed amounts such as the stamp; enter 0 for an excluded purchase or an exempt supplier, or the rate that applies to the supplier.
form.withholding_hint_always: Proposed at {{rate}}%; enter 0 for an excluded purchase or an exempt supplier, or the rate that applies to the supplier.
form.withholding_hint_several: Enter the rate that applies to the supplier, or 0 for an excluded purchase or an exempt supplier.
